s00EADB.name: Mario block and slope collision (rest)
summary: Second half of Mario's tile collision. Sets up the collision points for Mario's size, then checks body, side, head and feet points
against the Map16 tile. Page 0 tiles run effects (doors, coins), tiles $11-$6D are solid blocks, $6E-$D7 are slopes whose shape
comes from the table at [$82]. Handles wall-running ([$13E3]), floor landing, switch palace blocks, ledge pushing and Mario's state on landing.
Parameters: [RAM_MarioXPos]/[RAM_MarioYPos]; Y = tile number from CODE_00F44D. $00EAE9: wall-run handling, $00EB77: normal collision.
Contains helper entries: $00EFBC conveyor tiles, $00EFE8 wall-run point check, $00F005 wall-run start, $00F04D slope tile test (RTL).

CallGroundPound.name: Cape ground pound on landing
summary: Called when Mario lands with [$1407] >= 5 (cape dive). If he came from the air ([$8F] non-zero) runs GroundPound and plays sound $09.

s00F05C.name: Table: bounce block sprite by block
summary: Indexed by acts-like tile - $11 ($24 entries): which bounce block sprite is shown when the block is hit.

s00F080.name: Table: item spawned by block
summary: Which power-up/sprite a block releases. Bit 7 set marks special cases: $FF uses a fixed item, others pick one by block X position.

s00F0A4.name: Table: hit directions that trigger block
summary: Bit masks ANDed with DATA_00F0EC[Y]; zero means the hit direction does not activate this block.

s00F0C8.name: Table: tile a block turns into
summary: Value stored in $07 for the bounce block; most entries are $0D (used block).

s00F0EC.name: Table: bit masks for block hits
summary: First four bytes: hit direction masks. The rest are more masks (purpose uncertain).

s00F0F8.name: Table: block X positions and ? block contents
summary: DATA_00F0F8: X low bytes of blocks regenerated as used blocks. DATA_00F100: contents of special ? blocks by X position.
